fact: The locked Winter Walk Master Blueprint documents the prior OP adoption/support workflow as manual tracking across scattered emails, spreadsheets, and staff memory, then specifies a structured replacement workflow integrating Haku data processing, evidence tracking, reviewable follow-up, exception handling, and human approval.
source_location: Section 2 — prior-state OP adoption/support workflow (manual tracking across emails, spreadsheets, staff memory); Sections 3–5 — replacement operating workflow (internal support view, evidence layer, reviewable follow-up queue, Haku validate/map/route/stage/roll-up flow, Self-Report Form → Evidence Connector → Approval Sync, human approval for consequential actions)
notes: Design and operating-workflow documentation only. Describes documented current-state and specified replacement workflow; does not prove every component was implemented or deployed.
limitations: Does not prove implementation completeness or daily production use
Does not establish BPMN, formal enterprise process modeling, or process-reengineering leadership
Does not prove quantified process-improvement outcomes or organization-wide transformation
